labels.reasoning: This is a monster hand (set of 7s on 4c7d5s). Hero is OOP on a dry rainbow board with villain_air_pct=0.572 and fold_equity=0.592. BET for value and to deny equity to villain's 4.8% draw holdings.

This is a medium made hand (TT = top pair on Ts7d5c2d4c river). Hero is OOP on a rainbow board with villain_checked_back=1 — villain declined to bet on every street, a strong weakness signal. The river-checked-to pattern (per Calibration Notes d3178 anchor) fires: checked to OOP on river with showdown value and meaningful equity advantage. BET thin value.

CHECK is the alternative — OOP with draws is risky — but the nut FD plus meaningful air fraction supports a semi-bluff bet.
